scope: DE remote LCD capture, both web deployments, compatibility and Android OTA package selection

remote.image: 128 x 64 monochrome, one frozen 1024-byte frame on explicit request
checks: Firmware-generated replies consumed by production JS; reconstructed bytes match expected pixels
Minimum and negotiated GATT sizes, matching sequences, bounds, cancellation, disconnect and retries
Chrome DE and EN with simulated Bluetooth; preview, PNG download, rotation, failed refresh, new snapshot and keypad navigation
Legacy DE firmware can navigate without receiving a display command
Explicit status receipt and DE/PixLink file handoffs after cancelled connections

limits: Radio and physical LCD comparison on App647 are pending.
